title: Titanium Anode Basket Bottom Plate
system: Electroplating Anode Baskets & Current Delivery Systems
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for this anode system application prioritizing formability and corrosion resistance over strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, its natural TiO2 passivation provides immunity to pitting in chlorides up to 260C. This rationale is driven by double-layer micro-perforated anode basket bottom and fat life requirements.
process: CNC machining CP Ti for anode system geometry
TIG welding Ti filler with SPC sampling
Pickling and passivation with SPC sampling
Continuity test <1 mOhm with SPC sampling
surfaceTreatment: Platinum cladding 2.5um minimum via electrodeposition for stable catalytic surface in electrochemical cells
commonFailures: Precious metal drag-out >15% on complex racks - minimized by robotic extract 0.5m/min + air knife

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Anode Basket Bottom Plate suitable for Double-layer micro-perforated anode basket bottom?
faq.a: Titanium Anode Basket Bottom Plate uses Grade 2 CP-Ti because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address anode system operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Anode Basket Bottom Plate?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Anode Basket Bottom Plate require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. anode system components receive Platinum cladding 2.5um minimum via electrodeposition for stable catalytic surface in electrochemical cells. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the service environment.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Anode Basket Bottom Plate shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements; (4) Surface roughness certification on critical features. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for Bottom plate / Perforated plate anode system components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
